q1.explanationZh: 第二段说150年前所有信件和文件都是手写的。

evidence.quote: all letters and papers were written by hand

q2.explanationZh: 第三段说最早的打字机又大又重。

evidence.quote: The first typewriters were big and heavy.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because he wants to explain more clearly how early typewriters worked.

keyPoints.descZh: 为了更清楚地说明早期打字机的工作原理
examples: to explain how early typewriters worked

q3.rubricZh: 要点：为了说明早期打字机怎么工作。
q3.explanationZh: 第四段讲完钢琴后说“早期打字机很相似”，所以作者是借钢琴来解释打字机的原理。

q4.sampleAnswer: The levers would easily jam if a user pressed two keys quickly.

examples: if you pressed two keys quickly

q4.rubricZh: 要点：快速按下两个键时，杠杆容易卡住。
q4.explanationZh: 第五段说字母按顺序排的话，如果快速连按两个键，杠杆就容易卡在一起。

evidence.quote: If you pressed two keys quickly, the levers would easily jam.

q5.sampleAnswer: Yes, it has. Because it turned out to be a great success and people around the world learnt to use it; no other key arrangement has beaten it.

keyPoints.descZh: 回答 Yes，已被广泛接受
用原文支持：非常成功，世界各地的人都学会用，没有别的排列能超过它
examples: it turned out to be a great success and people around the world learnt to use it

q5.rubricZh: 要点：回答“是”，并引用文章依据（大获成功、世界各地的人都学会使用、没有别的排列能打败它）。
q5.explanationZh: 第六、七段说 QWERTY 大获成功，世界各地的人都学会了用，别的排列也没能超过它，所以很受欢迎。

evidence.quote: It turned out to be a great success.
none has been good enough to beat QWERTY

q6.sampleAnswer: No, because I am so familiar with the QWERTY keyboard that I can type without looking at the keys. If I change to another keyboard arrangement, I will type more slowly.(Answers may vary.)

examples: I am so familiar with the QWERTY keyboard that I can type without looking at the keys.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：明确表态（感兴趣/不感兴趣），并给出合理理由即可。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。先说感不感兴趣，再给理由，比如已经习惯了 QWERTY，或者想试试更快的排列。

evidence.quote: It is very difficult now to get people to change to any other key arrangement.

q7.explanationZh: 句子说“他赢了我并拿了奖”，过去的事，beat 的过去式还是 beat。

q8.explanationZh: was just 后面接 -ing，表示“我刚才在想你能不能帮我”，用 wondering。
q8.tipsZh: I was wondering if... 委婉地请求

q9.explanationZh: a 后面要名词，in a mess 表示“乱成一团”，由 messy 变成名词 mess。

q10.explanationZh: a wonderful 后要名词，传真机是一项“发明”，用 invention（inventor 的相关名词）。

q11.explanationZh: have difficulty (in) doing sth 表示“做某事有困难”，difficulty 是名词。

q12.explanationZh: is 后面要形容词，similar to 表示“和……相似”。

accept: turn the clock back to the 1970s
turn back the clock to the 1970s

q13.explanationZh: “让时光倒流”是 turn the clock back，let’s 后面接动词原形，to the 1970s 表示回到七十年代。

accept: At the end of each chapter

q14.explanationZh: “在……末尾”是 at the end of，句首要大写 At。

accept: turned out to be a complete failure
turned out to be a total failure

q15.explanationZh: “结果是”用 turn out to be，过去式 turned out to be，“彻底的失败”是 a complete failure。

q16.explanationZh: “此后”用 since，“被发现”要用被动，主语是 cases（复数），用现在完成时被动 have since been discovered。

accept: is claimed to be the first man to land on the moon
is claimed to be the first person to land on the moon

q17.explanationZh: “据称”用 be claimed to be，后面接“第一个登月的人”the first man to land on the moon。

accept: none has been lucky enough to
no one has been lucky enough to

q18.explanationZh: “没有一个人”用 none 或 no one，“足够幸运”是 lucky enough to，用现在完成时 has been。
